## Checklist
- [ ] Branch name follows `feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`, `chore/` or `release/x.y.z`; PR title is a Conventional Commit
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tests added or updated first for hook/script behavior
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] README/docs updated if behavior or commands changed
- [ ] Conventional Commit messages, no AI attribution
